original_ai_output.title_zh: 加纳进口商现可用塞地-人民币交易支付中国商品，无需美元
original_ai_output.summary_zh: 加纳从中国进口商品的企业现可通过加纳塞地账户发起符合条件的付款，该安排由Stanbic Bank Ghana试点推行。加纳央行（BoG）寻求减少该国双边贸易对美元的依赖。该消息目前为单一来源报道。

key_facts.fact: 加纳进口商现可通过塞地-人民币交易支付中国商品，无需美元
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ghanaian importers can now pay for Chinese goods using cedi-yuan transactions without dollars

key_facts.fact: 该付款安排由Stanbic Bank Ghana试点推行
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: Ghanaian businesses importing goods from China can initiate eligible payments from their Ghana cedi accounts under a new banking arrangement being piloted by Stanbic Bank Ghana

key_facts.fact: 加纳央行寻求减少双边贸易对美元的依赖
key_facts.evidence_excerpt: as the Bank of Ghana (BoG) seeks to reduce the country’s reliance on the US dollar for bilateral trade
